messages:
alex: Quick question for q2 capacity planning — projections show ~22% q/q growth in hosted inference hours. Need a buy vs lease recommendation for H100s + a burst plan (L4s or spot) before we lock the budget. can we get numbers by EOD?

maya: Sending a rough sketch here, happy to refine. baseline current usage = ~600k GPU hours/month (H100-equivalent). our monthly growth curve gives: `baseline 600k -> q2 avg 730k -> q3 avg 890k -> q4 peak 1.05M` (seasonal marketing + new PLG flows).

ryan: APAC region note: we hit NIC quota during last surge and cross-region egress spiked 38%. if we add capacity, prefer local footprints (smaller buy pools per region) to avoid egress/backhaul costs.

jamie: High level cost numbers for modelling (all $/GPU-hour): lease H100 = $4.8/hr, committed lease discount target = $3.9/hr at 12mo commit, amortized buy (incl DC + ops) = $2.05/hr over 36mo. break-even for buy vs lease (at these rates) ~22 months assuming constant utilization.

maya: Proposal A (conservative): buy 80 H100s (long-term baseline), lease 220 H100-equivalent for q2-q4 ramp, keep 150 L4s for burst (cheaper ops, lower power). Estimated monthly hours covered: buys @ 80*730*24*0.6 util ~= 281k hrs, leases cover rest.

maya: Proposal B (opportunistic): lease 100 committed + 300 short-term lease/spot, buy 40 H100s. Lower capital outlay, higher variable cost but more flexibility for model churn.

alex: Can you drop those proposals into a one-pager with: 1) monthly GPU-hour coverage, 2) cost delta vs fully-lease, 3) utilization sensitivity (50/60/75%), and 4) regional split (NA/EU/APAC). Need for TL review tomorrow.

ryan: Also add network cost line per region: NA baseline egress $0.02/GB, APAC observed $0.09/GB on peak. That changes the delta when cross-region routing is used.

jamie: Finance preference: aim for ~50-65% utilization on buys (to avoid stranded capacity) — that pushes us toward a larger lease mix initially. Also remind: capex approval lead time ~6-8 weeks for on-prem buys.

maya: Quick sensitivity snippet I put in the doc:
```
Assumptions: monthly hours target = 750k
Buy amortized = $2.05/hr, Lease committed = $3.9/hr, Lease spot avg = $4.8/hr
Scenarios:
 - 60% util buys: delivered cost = buy_cost*util + lease_cost*(remaining_hours)
 - 75% util buys: lowers blended $/hr by ~12%
```

alex: Nice. ops-bot, please post the current pool utilization graphs to the thread.

ops-bot: Posted: /dashboards/fleet/utilization qtr-view (snapshot attached). :white_check_mark:

maya: Follow-ups: 1) I'll model NA/EU/APAC splits tomorrow morning, 2) will include egress delta, 3) will add a short runbook for spillover -> L4s/spot.

alex: Thanks — set up a 30m sync at 10:30 PT tomorrow. please bring the one-pager and the sensitivity table. :thumbsup:

ryan: I'll audit NIC quotas in APAC before the meeting and flag any purchase that needs regional validation. :eyes:

jamie: I'll prep capex note and the 6–8 week procurement timeline.

maya: Roger. aiming to have doc + spreadsheet by 09:30 PT.

alex: Perfect — if anything shows >15% cost delta vs current run rate, flag for exec review.

ryan: small nit: we should include a fallback policy to auto-scale to cheaper quantized model variants during spikes, reduces hours by ~18% in tests.

maya: noted — will add model-variant fallback as an operational lever.

alex: Great work team.
